body:
## What to build

Part of #329; observed in candidate evaluation #338. Preserve the event to which a supplied date belongs when writing a customer case. This is a concrete Source Fidelity rejection, not a proposal for another general writing rule.

On `d60c4fc`, corpus `6e531f5`, GPT-6-astra/high and native Codex CLI 0.155.1, `/write --genre=case-study --language=en_GB --output=response source.md` produced:

> Before the trial began in September 2025, telephone reports and emails were stored separately.

The frozen source says that in September 2025 the maintenance team **decided to trial** a shared repair log. It gives the duration (eight weeks) and an internal-note date (4 December), but no actual start date. The output assigns September to commencement rather than the supplied decision. Neither plausible timing nor the later note establishes that date.

Evidence lives in `docs/evaluation/editorial-329/runs/candidate/case-study-en_GB/write/`: `supplied-input.md`, `artifact.md`, complete response and native traces. The independent F1 judgment is in `docs/evaluation/records/write-gpt-2026-09-19-338-part-article-case.md`. Redline receives only the draft, so it cannot be required to discover this hidden source mismatch.

Check whether the current source-fidelity contract already handles the distinction before adding any instruction. If a revision is warranted, address the actual ambiguity or conflicting instruction; keep the frozen material and failed observation intact. Several different faithful wordings can pass.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The observed unsupported chronology remains recorded as an F1 failure, including exact input and output evidence.
- [ ] A real new candidate run is judged independently against the frozen matrix; the decision date is not silently converted to a trial-start date.
- [ ] Redline is judged only against text-visible support and claim preservation; no inaccessible-source check is imposed.
- [ ] Any changed instruction addresses a demonstrated cause without prescribing this fixture’s wording.
- [ ] The four checks in CONTRIBUTING.md pass for the integrated change.

---
Written against d60c4fc

Alla övriga Write-kriterier passerar; källblind Redline lämnar den fulla artefakten oförändrad efter verklig review och en installerad Proofread-pass. Rötterna är städade efter full evidensfångst.

Den här revisionen innehåller en operativ kontroll av Writes befintliga Source Fidelity samt precisering av citatöversättning. Ingen regel om just månad eller försöksstart har tillkommit. Ett lyckat nytt stickprov bevisar varken vilken ändring som påverkade utfallet eller garanterad reparation av framtida stokastiska kronologiavvikelser.

Avslutat som uppfylld lokal leverans.

Den ursprungliga felaktiga startdateringen är bevarad. Nytt case-study/en_GB på29ff204 håller september som beslutstid, utan att hävda en deterministisk reparation av framtida modellfel. Källblind Redline bedöms separat.

Lokalt integrerat i `main` vid `579ec85ee9d49c0ec65039e96d005c11fb7c98ac`; inga commits har pushats och aktiv installation är inte uppdaterad. Fyra CONTRIBUTING-kontroller passerar, inklusive 1 873 tester. Evidens: `docs/evaluation/editorial-329/runs/rerun-341-translation/case-study-en_GB`. Samlat läspaket: `docs/evaluation/editorial-329/README.md`. Tekniskt godkännande innebär inte att samtliga provtexter passerar.

Reopened after independent review of the source-check candidate `8f92e12`. All three new `case-study-en_US` Write samples attach September 2025 to both the trial decision and supplier selection through a coordinated clause. The frozen source dates only the decision; it does not date supplier selection. This is the same event/date-preservation requirement as this issue, involving a different undated event from the original trial-start observation.

The fresh checkers returned no findings, so the new process has a repeated source-support miss. All three outputs remain F1 failures; provisional passes receive visible superseding judgements. Source-blind Redline is assessed separately. Evidence: `docs/evaluation/editorial-329/followup/runs/candidate/case-study-en_US-r{1,2,3}/`, with full source, draft, response, native traces and inventories. The final independent reviewer and the original evaluator confirmed the date scope separately.

A proposition-level support-accounting probe is now testing the checker before further product changes. No date-specific sentence or fixture wording will be added to runtime guidance. Original frozen source and all prior failures remain unchanged. #329 remains blocked by source-fidelity defects.

title: Preserve the event associated with a supplied date in customer cases
